D: A grieving mother and her son are haunted by a sinister storybook creature.
P: Serve dessert when Amelia reads the pop-up book.
S: Pop-up book crackers and olive tapenade
crisp flatbread draped like pages, black olive and anchovy spread, whipped feta, ba-ba-dook

Lavash crackers baked folded like an open book, with a jet black olive and anchovy tapenade and a whipped feta for the white pages. Cut 2 lavash sheets into 16 rectangles, score each down the middle, brush with olive oil and salt and drape over a rolling pin so they bake half open. Bake at 180C for 8 minutes. Blitz 200g pitted kalamata olives, 4 anchovies, 1 garlic clove, 1 tbsp capers, lemon juice and 60ml olive oil to a paste. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt. Serve both with the crackers.
Popcorn tossed in butter, black pepper and grated parmesan

Kernels popped in a lidded pot with a little oil, tossed hot in melted butter, heaps of cracked black pepper, grated parmesan and fine salt. Pop 120g kernels in a lidded pot with 2 tbsp oil. Toss straight away in 50g melted butter, 2 tsp cracked black pepper, 40g finely grated parmesan and fine salt so it all sticks while the corn is hot.
Buttered white bread coated in sprinkles, crusts off, cut into triangles

Fresh white bread spread right to the edges with soft butter, pressed face down into a plate of hundreds and thousands, crusts trimmed and cut into triangles. Make it close to serving so it stays soft.
M: Lamb shanks braised with red wine, tomato and rosemary
Lamb shanks browned, braised at 160C for 3 hours with onion, carrot, red wine, tomato and rosemary. Mash.
Amelia up all night with the TV and no sleep

Sourdough toasted in butter with vintage cheddar, a smear of Dijon and shaved leg ham, the outside crusted with parmesan, with tomato chutney for dipping. Butter one side of 8 slices sourdough. Mix 250g grated vintage cheddar with 2 tbsp mayonnaise. Lay 4 slices buttered side down, spread with Dijon, top with the cheese mix and 150g shaved leg ham, and close. Sprinkle 30g finely grated parmesan onto the buttered outsides. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until deep golden. Rest 1 minute, cut and serve with 150g tomato chutney.
W: Biscuit base, lemon condensed milk layer and raspberry jelly on top

A proper Aussie jelly slice with a buttery biscuit base, a tangy condensed milk and lemon middle and a wobbly raspberry jelly top. Press 250g crushed biscuits and 125g melted butter into a tin. Dissolve 1 tbsp gelatine in 60ml hot water, mix with 395g condensed milk and the juice of 2 lemons and spread over. Set, then pour over 1 cooled packet of raspberry jelly and chill.
K: Warm milk with honey, cinnamon and brandy, nutmeg on top

Full cream milk warmed with honey, vanilla and cinnamon, finished with a nip of brandy and a grating of nutmeg, served in mugs before bed. Warm 800ml full cream milk in a saucepan with 3 tbsp honey, 1 cinnamon stick and half a tsp vanilla extract until steaming, without boiling. Leave to infuse 5 minutes and remove the cinnamon. Whisk until frothy. Pour into 4 mugs, add 20ml brandy to each, and finish with grated nutmeg. Leave the brandy out for the kids.
